artworks.label: River reed nest
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for kingfisher-blue. A small beautifully woven natural river-reed nest cradling two smooth ivory kingfisher eggs, a few slender golden reed tips arching around its edge, one clear dew bead with faint teal reflected light. Fine-art natural wildlife macro photography, authentic fine reed fibres, soft powder-river-blue reflected light, warm copper-gold and cream with restrained teal accents. No bird, diving splash or detached feather; nest and eggs are the new subject. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
